FN-11SADZZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 249
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/27/2026
House Bill 249 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Institute to prepare or approve a training program in conjunction with the Alabama Probate
Judges Association for guardian ad litems pursuant to the provisions of this bill. This bill would
not otherwise affect state or local funding.
